title: Neumorphic Panel
description: A soft extruded panel with a light highlight and a faint shadow, raised or pressed, with an optional toggle button.
docs:
Installed `NeumorphicPanel`. Import it from `@/components/ui/neumorphic-panel` and put it on a surface of the same color: `<NeumorphicPanel state="raised">Label</NeumorphicPanel>`. The effect is a light highlight toward the top start and a faint shadow toward the bottom end; `state="pressed"` adds inner shadows. With `pressable` it is a toggle button whose `aria-pressed` state is the pressed look.

The page behind it must be `--neumorphic-panel-surface` (#e8eae9 by default) for the illusion to read. The colors are the `--neumorphic-panel-*` variables (light and dark); `--neumorphic-panel-size` sets the width (300px). The default text is faint by design: under `prefers-contrast: more` it and the edge are lifted, and you can set `--neumorphic-panel-foreground` to make that the default.

Ported from the CodePen "Neumorphic shadows" by Una Kravets (MIT, copyright 2026 Una Kravets); the license text is in the file.

props.name: state
props.description: The pen's raised look (a highlight and a shadow outside) or its pressed look (the same plus two inner shadows). Ignored when `pressable`.

props.name: pressable
props.description: Render a toggle button (`aria-pressed`) instead of a div; its pressed state is the pressed look.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed / onPressedChange
props.description: Controlled or initial pressed state of a `pressable` panel, and its change callback.

props.name: className / children
props.description: Classes for the root, and its content. All other div (or button) props pass through.

a11y: A plain panel is a div with no role. A pressable panel is a native button with aria-pressed: Enter and Space toggle it, and a visible focus outline appears for keyboard focus only.

The pressed look only changes shadows, so the state is carried by aria-pressed for assistive technology; under prefers-contrast: more and forced colors the pressed state also gets a heavier double border.

Contrast (fidelity default, contrast on request): the pen's text is #ced3d9 on #e8eae9 (1.25:1) and its edge is a soft shadow, a known deviation from AA kept for fidelity. Under prefers-contrast: more the text becomes #4b525c (6.5:1) and the panel gets a 2px edge; under forced colors it uses ButtonText with a border. Set --neumorphic-panel-foreground to make the higher contrast the default.
Reduced motion: the pressed look changes instantly; otherwise the shadow eases for 200ms.
